sermons.title: Sermon 508 | Comfort To Seekers From What The Lord Has Not Said

scripture.verse: "I have not spoken in secret, in a dark place of the earth: I said not unto the seed of Jacob, Seek you Me in vain."

sermons.title: Sermon 509 | Lead Us Not Into Temptation

scripture.verse: "Lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil."
"Therefore, beingjustified by faith, we havepeace with God through ourLord Jesus Christ."

"When the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one accord in one place. And suddenly there came a sound from Heaven as of a rushing mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting. And there appeared unto them cloven tongues like as of fire, and it sat upon each of them. And they were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit ga ve them utterance."

sermons.title: Sermon 512 | A Precious Drop Of Honey

scripture.verse: "Behold, I have inscribed you upon the palms of My hands."
"O satisfy us early with Your mercy, that we may rejoice and be glad all our days."
"But the woman fearing and trembling, knowing what was done in her, came and fell down before Him and told Him all the truth."
"My little children, these things write I unto you, that you sin not. And if any man sins, we have an Advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous"
"And some believed the things which were spoken and some believed not."
